en.title: The simple present
en.summary: The simple present describes habits, facts and things that are always true.

paragraphs: The simple present describes habits, facts and things that are always true. It does not show an action happening at this moment. It is the first tense that learners meet, and it is used in very many sentences.

Use the base form, and add -s for he, she and it. Verbs ending in s, sh, ch, x or o add -es, and consonant + y changes to ies. Questions and negatives use do and does with the base form. The main verb never takes -s after does.

blocks.html:
FormExample
affirmativeHe works.
negativeHe doesn't work.
questionDoes he work?
with -esShe watches TV.
y → iesIt carries water.

paragraphs: We answer with do or does: Do you like tea? Yes, I do. Does she work here? No, she doesn't. The answer repeats the auxiliary, not the main verb.
The simple present is common with words such as always, never, every day, on Mondays and usually. These words show that the action is repeated, not that it happens at this moment.

items: Wrong: **He work here.** Right: **He works here.**
Wrong: **Does he works?** Right: **Does he work?**
Wrong: **She doesn't works.** Right: **She doesn't work.**

ro.title: Prezentul simplu
ro.summary: Timpul prezent arată acțiuni obișnuite, fapte generale sau adevăruri din viața de zi cu zi.

paragraphs: Timpul prezent arată o acțiune obișnuită sau un adevăr general. Folosim prezentul și pentru lucruri care se întâmplă chiar acum. În limba română, nu avem o formă separată pentru prezentul continuu.

items: Eu **lucrez** la birou în fiecare zi.

paragraphs: Verbele își schimbă terminația după persoană. De obicei, nu folosim pronume precum „eu” sau „tu”, deoarece forma verbului arată deja cine face acțiunea. Pentru negație, punem cuvântul „nu” înaintea verbului.
